Subject: MAP prototype: starter doc and week0 ops slides

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great speaking with you earlier. Per our call, I've put together a lightweight MAP prototype that focuses on a 30-day evaluation with clear success criteria and a compact "week0" ops checklist so your infra and security teams can validate readiness quickly. The goal: a one-page acceptance matrix + 3-slide tech readiness stub that we can iterate in the kickoff.

What I'm sharing here is intentionally minimal so we can lock owners and dates this week. Two links below (view/comment):
- MAP starter doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB-map-starter-doc
- Week0 ops slides (slides stub): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1aB-week0-slides

Quick ask: can you confirm target attendees for the kickoff (we usually keep it to Product, Security, and one infra lead) and your preferred window for a 30–45 minute sync this week?

Next steps I'm proposing if that helps streamline momentum:
1) Kickoff (45 min) — align stakeholders, finalize acceptance criteria
2) Tech prep (week0) — security checklist + access setup
3) 30-day pilot (milestones + weekly health check)

I've attached (linked) the starter doc and slides. Marissa will own the success criteria templates; Jasmine will run the technical checklist; Karthik will coordinate quota/throughput targets with your team.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher

Sean —

Thanks for this and for the call. The docs look good at a glance. Couple quick things from our side:
- We'll want the acceptance criteria to include a latency SLA for the inference path and a sample set size for quality checks (we typically use ~5k tokens across 200 prompts).
- Security wants a short section listing where logs are stored and retention for audit purposes.

Attendees for kickoff: myself (Product), Tom (Infra lead), Priya (Security lead, copying offline), and I can invite our ML lead if you think that's helpful.

Available windows: Tue 27 May between 09:30–11:00 PT or Wed 28 May 14:00–15:00 PT. Either works for us.

Also can you add a short "decision owners" table in the doc so we have single owners for each acceptance item? Makes sign-off quicker.

Appreciate it — Sam

Samantha Price
Head of Product, HorizonBio
samantha.price@horizonbio.com

- Jasmine Liu: Expand week0 ops slide with access steps and a short list of expected firewall/IP allow entries (due Wed 10:00 PT, will review in kickoff).

Thanks everyone — invite received. I updated the Week0 slides with our internal IP ranges and added a short note on expected throughput during the pilot (we're planning for a ~10k tokens/day load initially).

Looking forward to the kickoff.
